name: pglife
description: PG Life — property rental platform. Next.js frontend + Express/Prisma API on PostgreSQL.

scripts.build: npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix api run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix web run lint && npm --prefix api run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix api run typecheck
scripts.db:setup: npm --prefix api run prisma:migrate && npm --prefix api run seed
